title: The Scaly Trail
intro: This quiz follows Nia and Ben as they learn what makes reptiles different from other animals.

questions.prompt: What type of skin do reptiles have?
questions.explanation: Reptiles have dry skin covered with scales.

questions.prompt: Why did the turtle stretch toward the Sun?
choices: To dry its shell after swimming
To look for food in the sky
questions.explanation: The turtle stretched toward the Sun to warm its body.

questions.prompt: What does it mean that reptiles are ectothermic?
choices: They make all their own body heat
They depend on their surroundings to help control body temperature
They can live only in cold water
questions.explanation: Ectothermic reptiles depend on their surroundings to help control body temperature.
Turtle, snake, lizard, and crocodile are all reptiles.

questions.prompt: Which statement about reptile eggs is usually true?
choices: They are usually laid in water with no covering
They usually have a protective shell and are laid on land
They are carried inside a pouch
questions.explanation: Reptile eggs usually have a protective shell and are laid on land.
